rules.heading: THE LORDS OF THE 10 MONTHS OF CONCEPTION AND THE DETERMINION OF THE STRENGTH OF THE MOON

planetary.freeform: The Lord of the first month of conception is Venus; of the 2nd, Mars; of the 3rd, Jupiter; of the 4th, the Sun; of the 5th, the Moon; of the 6th, Saturn; of the 7th, Mercury; of the 8th, the Ascendant Lord; of the 9th, the Moon; and of the 10th, the Sun. For marriage and conception, the Chandra Bala of the woman is considered; for other samskaras, that of the husband.

rules.notes: Details the ruling planets for each of the 10 months of gestation and specifies whose Chandra Bala (Moon strength) to consult for different samskaras.
